suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Resolution 2026 publishes this relationship only as treatment complication. Require documented retinal-detachment surgery involving pars plana vitrectomy (with or without scleral buckle as applicable) and separately documented postoperative cataract progression. Do not infer cataract from untreated retinal detachment. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Documentation of the qualifying treatment/procedure exposure for Retinal Detachment
Independent diagnosis of Cataracts and timing relative to that exposure
Dose, duration, procedure details, and relevant co-exposures where applicable
Qualified clinical assessment of competing causes and exact source-phenotype fit
